$comment: Speed context for route scoring (T-47). A defect matters more at 90 km/h than at 30 km/h. Speed = the OSM maxspeed tag when present (parsed at segment build time into road_segments.maxspeed_kmh), else default_kmh_by_highway[highway], else fallback_kmh. speed_factor = speed / reference_kmh. Changing these needs no segment rebuild.
